title: Nightruth: Explanation of the Paranormal: Futatsu dake no Shinjitsu
native_title: ナイトゥルース 「二つだけの真実」
overview:
An evil shadow lurking in the darkness..........

Five loves will save a sorrowful heart with nowhere to go!

The disappearance of the spirit sword Secundadei, Ai's inexplicable behavior... Who is the strongest enemy in the series, appearing before the five lured into the darkness...? The violent personality Haruka that dwells within the innocent Ai, and her sorrowful past, are here, now...

闇に潜みし邪まな影………。

行き場のない哀しき心を、五つの愛が救う！

霊剣セクンダディの失踪、藍の不可解な行動…。闇に誘われた5人の前にあらわれたシリーズ最強の敵とは……？無邪気な藍に棲む、荒ぶる人格・遥、その哀しき過去が、いま、ここに……。
